notes: Mutable ATO facts. Re-verify at use time. This index is provenance, not a substitute for a live source check.

sources.title: Business activity statements (BAS)
sources.fact: BAS labels, reporting method, and lodgment cycle are read from the entity's statement and current ATO guidance, not assumed.

sources.title: How GST works
sources.fact: GST registration basis (cash or accruals) must match the report basis before any label is mapped.

sources.title: Pay as you go (PAYG) withholding
sources.fact: A large withholder reporting through STP no longer needs to report an amount at W1. That relief is a large-withholder rule, not a rule for every STP reporter.

sources.title: Activity statement instructions
sources.fact: Simpler BAS entities report G1, 1A and 1B in the GST section where the current turnover test is met. G10/G11 capital vs non-capital mapping follows the entity's reporting method.
